# anthropic_rbac_groups (Data Source)

Lists RBAC groups in a Claude Enterprise organization. Requires `enterprise_api_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_groups" "all" {}

output "scim_groups" {
  value = [for g in data.anthropic_rbac_groups.all.groups : g.name if g.source_type == "scim"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Group id.
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `roles` (List of String) RBAC role ids assigned to the group; null when temporarily unavailable.
- `source_type` (String) `direct` or `scim`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
